brief: An original editorial-marketing symbol: a deep-magenta MEGAPHONE whose broad front cone is formed by one sculpted blush-paper fold, with a single lavender fountain-PEN NIB integrated diagonally along its body. It must immediately communicate writing/refining advertising messages, not a decorative flower, generic book or chat app. Only megaphone + paper fold + clear pen nib, one coherent compact silhouette. Magenta #782859, blush #F9DAE0 and soft lavender #D6B0FC. No letters, calligraphy, speech text, approval checks, decorative petals or national symbols. Refined tactile surfaces, minimal fine detail.
